# Getharvest — Style Reference

> Letterpress ledger on oat paper, one ember thread. Besley headlines set at weight 400 sit on a #fbf5f0 linen canvas, drawn with 1px grey hairlines, with a single burnt-orange mark reserved for the logo and hero.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Harvest speaks a warm-ledger product language: a time-tracking SaaS that sets its headlines in Besley, a Clarendon-descended book serif, at weight 400, where most of the category uses a bold geometric sans. The canvas is #fbf5f0 linen. White #ffffff lifts the nav, menus and carousel bands, and sand #f3ebe4 recesses story cards and tiles. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue, ember #fa5d00, and it is limited to the logo mark, the hero underline, the hero video frame and the trial checkmarks. Every action button is black. Typography carries the hierarchy through size jumps of 16 → 30 → 50 → 70px with no weight increase. Muoto VAR handles UI and body at 400/500, and every size carries negative tracking from −0.01em to −0.04em. Shapes are soft-pill: 30px buttons, 20px cards and a 40px floating nav. Elevation comes mostly from tonal shifts, with four rare shadows. The effect reads as a printed business almanac rather than a dashboard vendor.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linen Canvas | `#fbf5f0` | `--color-linen-canvas` | Body background, hero band, feature-tab section and logo strip (9 fills). This warm 2% tint keeps pure-black type from reading clinical. |
| Paper | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper` | Floating nav pill, mega-menu panels, workflow carousel band, tab-bar tray (17 fills). On linen, white reads as lifted rather than default. |
| Sand Surface | `#f3ebe4` | `--color-sand-surface` | Customer story cards, integration tiles and the active feature tab (8 fills). This recessed tonal layer groups content without needing a border. |
| Jet | `#000000` | `--color-jet` | Feature h3s, mega-menu links, primary CTA fill and the approval toast (108 text uses, 7 fills). The workhorse ink and the only action color. |
| Onyx Ink | `#1d1e1c` | `--color-onyx-ink` | h1 and h2 serif headlines, the hero email-submit fill and carousel arrow glyphs. This softened near-black stops 70px serifs from turning harsh. |
| Iron Text | `#626262` | `--color-iron-text` | Testimonial attribution and secondary meta lines (15 uses). A quiet mid-grey for supporting copy that still has to be read. |
| Slate Tab | `#666666` | `--color-slate-tab` | Inactive feature-tab labels at 13px (7 uses). It recedes so that the single active tab carries the selection state. |
| Pewter Nav | `#6a696a` | `--color-pewter-nav` | Top-nav dropdown triggers (Features, Solutions, Resources) at 18px (7 uses). It keeps the navigation softer than the black CTAs beside it. |
| Ash Caption | `#8b8b8b` | `--color-ash-caption` | Uppercase menu eyebrows, feature descriptions and tile captions (39 uses, the second-most-used text color). It sits at about 3.2:1 on linen. Do not set paragraphs longer than three lines in it. |
| Steel Outline | `#999999` | `--color-steel-outline` | 1px border on secondary pill buttons such as Contact sales and Features overview (4 uses). It is visible enough to outline a ghost action without competing with black fills. |
| Dove Border | `#d3d3d3` | `--color-dove-border` | Logo-strip rule lines, "Learn more" button borders and menu dividers (6 uses). This is the structural hairline that separates content without boxing it. |
| Mist Hairline | `#1d1e1c1a` | `--color-mist-hairline` | Disabled carousel-arrow ring and soft card dividers (4 uses). At 10% Onyx it is a translucent edge that tints toward whatever surface sits beneath. |
| Ember Signal | `#fa5d00` | `--color-ember-signal` | Logo mark, hero word underline, video frame and trial checkmarks. It is the brand's single saturated hue. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Muoto VAR — the soft grotesk that runs every UI string, label and paragraph · `--font-muoto-var`

- **Substitute:** Inter (variable) at 380 for body and 480 for emphasis, Instrument Sans at 400 and 500, Geist at 400 and 500. Muoto draws slightly light for its nominal weight, so Inter at a true 400 renders a touch heavier. Pull it down about 20 units.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 700
- **Sizes:** 13px, 14px, 16px, 17px, 18px, 19px, 26px, 30px
- **Line height:** 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** −0.39px (−0.03em) at 13px uppercase eyebrows, also 0px on sampled eyebrows; −0.13px at 13px tabs; −0.28px and −0.42px at 14px; −0.32px (−0.02em) at 16px body; −0.48px at 16px emphasis; −0.17px (−0.01em) at 17px button labels; −0.54px (−0.03em) at 18px; −0.57px at 19px; −0.52px and −0.78px at 26px; −0.9px (−0.03em) at 30px h3; −1.2px (−0.04em) at 30px display-lead
- **Role:** Muoto is the workhorse: 197 of 209 sampled text nodes use it. Weight 400 accounts for 122 of those and 500 for 70, and 700 appears only 5 times. That leaves the sans no room to shout, which hands all drama to the serif. Negative tracking at every size, including 13px, runs against convention, since small text usually opens up. Here even captions are tightened, so the UI reads as one dense, typeset voice rather than interface chrome.

### Besley — the Clarendon-flavoured book serif that sets every section headline · `--font-besley`

- **Substitute:** Besley itself (free on Google Fonts) at 400, Newsreader Display at 450 because it draws thinner than Besley, Roboto Serif at 400 with optical size 72 for display. Besley renders true to its nominal weight, so match 400 directly.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 18px, 50px, 70px
- **Line height:** 1.1, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** −0.54px at 18px, −2px (−0.04em) at 50px, −2.8px (−0.04em) at 70px
- **Role:** Besley at weight 400 is the signature move. A bracketed-slab serif normally signals newsprint or invoices, and Harvest bills by the hour, so the face is a literal fit for a ledger product. The 70 → 50px step is a 1.4 ratio, steeper than a Perfect Fourth (1.333). The jump from the 30px sans h3 to the 50px serif h2 is 1.67, which makes the serif feel like a separate register rather than a bigger size. The −0.04em tracking pulls the bracketed serifs into near-contact, giving the headlines a cast-metal density.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Muoto VAR | 500 | 13px | 1.2 | 0px (uppercase) | `--text-small` |
| caption | Muoto VAR | 400 | 14px | 1.5 | -0.28px | `--text-caption` |
| body | Muoto VAR | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | -0.32px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Muoto VAR | 400 | 18px | 1.0 | -0.54px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Muoto VAR | 400 | 26px | 1.3 | -0.52px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Muoto VAR | 400 | 30px | 1.2 | -0.9px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Besley | 400 | 50px | 1.1 | -2px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Besley | 400 | 70px | 1.1 | -2.8px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every h1 and h2 in Besley 400 at 70px or 50px with −0.04em tracking — the serif at regular weight is the system's voice, and size alone carries rank.
- Fill primary actions with #000000 on a 30px radius at 14px 20px padding — action is signalled by ink density, not hue.
- Keep the canvas at #fbf5f0 and lift panels to #ffffff — warm linen under white produces elevation without a shadow.
- Recess grouped content such as stories, tiles and active tabs onto #f3ebe4 with a 20px radius — the tonal step replaces borders and keeps cards flat.
- Track all Muoto text negative, from −0.01em at 17px to −0.04em at 30px — the tight set unifies UI and body into one typeset texture.
- Confine #fa5d00 to the logo, hero underline, hero video frame and checkmarks — ember works as a signature stamp, punctuation rather than decoration.
- Use 100px between major sections and 24px between elements — the comfortable rhythm lets 50px serif headlines breathe like chapter openers.

### Don't

- Don't bold the serif headlines to 600 or 700 — weight 400 at 70px is the thesis, and a heavy Besley turns the ledger into a tabloid.
- Don't paint the CTA #fa5d00 — an orange button splits attention between brand mark and action, and black-only actions are non-negotiable.
- Don't swap Besley for a geometric sans at 50px — the serif-on-SaaS contrast is the identity, and a sans h2 makes Harvest indistinguishable from every time tracker.
- Don't add borders to story cards on #f3ebe4 — a 1px #d3d3d3 frame around a tonal card double-codes the boundary and reads as wireframe.
- Don't use the lg shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.53)` on cards — it belongs only to overlays on video, and on linen it reads as a dropped sticker.
- Don't set long paragraphs in #8b8b8b — at 3.2:1 on #fbf5f0 Ash Caption is for 1–3 line descriptions only, and body copy belongs in #000000 or #626262.
- Don't open up tracking on the 13px uppercase eyebrows beyond 0px — wide-tracked caps are the SaaS default, and this system never loosens its type.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fbf5f0 (Linen Canvas)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- recessed surface: #f3ebe4 (Sand Surface)
- headline ink: #1d1e1c (Onyx Ink)
- secondary text: #8b8b8b (Ash Caption)
- border: #d3d3d3 (Dove Border)
- brand accent: #fa5d00 (Ember Signal)
- primary action: #000000 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars use neutral fills of #1d1e1c and #d3d3d3 by default, with saturated status hues kept inside product mockups and ember #fa5d00 limited to a single highlighted series at 100% or tints at 20% opacity. The accent is never the largest fill on a page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #000000, text #ffffff, 1px solid #000000 border, border-radius 30px, padding 14px 20px, rendered height 49px, font-family Muoto VAR (fallback Inter at 480) at 16px weight 500, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing −0.32px, no shadow. On hover, shift the background to #1d1e1c. Place a secondary twin beside it with a transparent background, #000000 text, 1px solid #999999 border and identical geometry, separated by 8px.

2. Build a hero section on background #fbf5f0, max-width 1296px, two equal columns with a 48px gap. Left column, centred: an h1 in Besley 400 at 70px, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing −2.8px, color #1d1e1c, with one key word underlined by a 3px #fa5d00 rule. Below it, 24px down, a lede in Muoto VAR 400 18px, line-height 1.5, color #626262, max-width 516px. Then a #ffffff email tray, 56px tall, border-radius 16px, shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 0 0 14px 0`, holding a #1d1e1c submit pill with #ffffff 17px weight 500 text, radius 30px and padding 0 24px. Below that, three 14px #626262 trust lines with #fa5d00 check icons, 24px apart. Right column: a video inside a 20px-radius frame with a 12px #fa5d00 border.

3. Build an Integration Tile: a top media area 100% wide and 200px tall, background #f3ebe4, border-radius 20px, overflow hidden, containing a #ffffff UI snippet with radius 10px offset to crop at the right edge. Below, 24px down, the title in Muoto VAR 400 at 26px, line-height 1.3, letter-spacing −0.52px, color #1d1e1c, followed 16px later by a description in 14px weight 400, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing −0.28px, color #8b8b8b. No border and no shadow. Arrange three tiles per row with a 24px gap.

4. Build a navigation bar: fixed at the top, a 93px header zone with a centred floating pill, max-width 1296px, background #ffffff, border-radius 40px, padding 8px 8px 8px 24px, shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 0 0 14px 0`. Left: the wordmark with its #fa5d00 bar mark. Centre: triggers in Muoto VAR 400 18px, letter-spacing −0.54px, color #6a696a, padding 8px 0, 24px apart, each with a chevron. Right: "Log in" in #000000 16px, an outline pill (1px #999999, radius 30px, padding 14px 20px) and a black pill (#000000 fill, #ffffff text, weight 500), 8px apart.

### Pill Button — Black (Primary)

**Role:** The single filled call-to-action

Choosing black over the ember brand hue is deliberate and anti-convention: action reads as typographic weight rather than color. Use it once per viewport for "Try Harvest free".

### Pill Button — Outline (Secondary)

**Role:** Ghost companion to the black pill

A grey-ruled twin. It has a transparent background over linen or white, #000000 text, a 1px #999999 border, 30px radius, 14px 20px padding, a 49px height, Muoto VAR at 16px weight 500 with −0.32px tracking, and no shadow. The menu variant "Features overview" shrinks to 12px 20px padding, a 43px height and 17px weight 500, with label color #4a4b49, a one-off graphite that is not a system token. It sits beside the primary CTA as "Contact sales", which keeps the pair as a filled/outlined echo of identical geometry.

### Floating Navigation Pill

**Role:** Fixed, rounded global navigation

A detached white capsule. The nav is position-fixed within a 93px header zone, filled #ffffff with a 40px radius and the subtle shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 0 0 14px`. It holds the Harvest wordmark with its #fa5d00 bar mark on the left and Pewter Nav #6a696a triggers in Muoto VAR 18px weight 400 (8px 0px padding, 37px tall) with chevrons in the centre. On the right sit "Log in" in #000000, then the outline and black pills. Floating the bar off the edges, instead of using a conventional full-bleed header, turns navigation into an object resting on paper.

### Mega-Menu Panel

**Role:** Multi-column dropdown directory

A white index card. The panel is #ffffff on a #000000b3 page scrim (decorative overlay, not a system token) and carries the sm shadow. Column eyebrows are Muoto VAR 13px weight 500 uppercase in #8b8b8b with 0px tracking. Links are 18px weight 400 #000000 at line-height 1.0 with −0.54px tracking, preceded by 1px line icons, and rows sit 24px apart. A featured "Report" slot uses a Sand Surface tile with a 20px radius and a white outline pill. The menu borrows the shape of a printed table of contents rather than a SaaS feature grid.

### Hero Email Capture

**Role:** Inline trial signup field

An input with a built-in pill. The tray is #ffffff with a 16px radius and a 56px height, and carries the subtle shadow. The placeholder is Muoto VAR 19px weight 500 in #1d1e1c at reduced opacity with −0.57px tracking. The embedded submit is #1d1e1c with #ffffff text, a 30px radius, 0px 24px padding, a 56px height and 17px weight 500. Three trust lines sit below in caption 14px #626262, each with a #fa5d00 tick. The submit uses Onyx Ink rather than Jet, a quieter black for a form already inside a surface.

### Feature Column (Workflow Carousel)

**Role:** Illustrated product pillar in a carousel

Borderless, surface-free columns. Each column is a 350px-wide link with no background, radius or shadow. It contains a 1px line illustration with an ember detail, an h3 in Muoto VAR 30px weight 400 #000000 with −0.9px tracking, a 16px weight 500 #000000 subline and 16px weight 400 body in #8b8b8b, then a "Learn more" button with a 1px #d3d3d3 border and a 6px radius. 40px circular arrow buttons sit top right (1px #1d1e1c1a ring) and use a 50% radius. Removing the card container is intentional: the band is a page of a catalogue, not a tile grid.

### Segmented Feature Tabs

**Role:** Switches the product demo panel

A white tray of chips. The tray is #ffffff with a 16px radius and 8px internal padding. Each tab is 40px tall with 10px 12px padding and a 10px radius, set in Muoto VAR 13px weight 400 #666666 with −0.13px tracking and preceded by a 1px icon. The active tab fills with #f3ebe4 and switches to weight 500 #000000. Eight options sit on one line at 1920px. Selection is signalled by a tonal fill rather than an underline or color, which keeps the ember hue out of the UI.

### Product Demo Panel

**Role:** Framed animated product mockup

A colored stage holding real UI. The panel is 20px-radius media on a full-bleed patterned backdrop, with olive greens that are mockup-internal and not system tokens. A white product table overlaps it, and a black #000000 toast pill ("Approve timesheets and expenses") sits on top with a 999px radius, #ffffff 18px text and a check glyph. The left rail lists sub-features with ">" markers at 16px weight 500 and 14px #8b8b8b descriptions. This is the only place large color fields are allowed, because they belong to the product, not the brand.

### Integration Tile

**Role:** Feature card with mini UI vignette

A sand-backed vignette card. The top is a Linen or Sand #f3ebe4 media area with a 20px radius and an inset white mockup that crops at the edge. Below, the title is Muoto VAR 26px weight 400 #1d1e1c with −0.52px tracking and the caption is 14px #8b8b8b at line-height 1.5, with 16px between them. The grid is three across, then two across for the integrations row. Saturated greens, blues and reds inside the vignettes are mockup-internal. The tile frames the product as a specimen rather than a hero shot.

### Customer Story Card

**Role:** Industry testimonial and metric card

A tall sand slab. It is an `article` 366px wide and 698px tall, filled #f3ebe4 with a 20px radius, 30px 20px 30px 30px padding and no border or shadow. It opens with a 13px weight 500 uppercase #8b8b8b industry label, followed by body text at 16px weight 400 with line-height 1.5. Attribution is 16px #626262 and quotes are set in Besley 18px with −0.54px tracking. The asymmetric right padding of 20px is deliberate, leaving room for a scroll affordance. This is the main content card: tonal, flat and generously padded.

### Logo Wall

**Role:** Social-proof customer strip

Monochrome marks, single row. A 14px #000000 sentence ("Over 70,000 companies…") sits between two 1px #d3d3d3 rules. Below it, eight customer logos rendered in #000000 at a fixed 50px height, with variable widths from 45px to 98px, run across the 1296px container with a wrapped ninth logo centred beneath. Stripping the brand color from every customer logo keeps the ember budget intact.

### Floating Video Control — Unmute (System Outlier)

**Role:** Overlay control on hero video

The one dark, shadowed chip. It is #1d1e1ccc (Onyx Ink at 80% opacity, an overlay value and not a system token) with #ffffff Muoto VAR 18px text, a 999px radius, 8px 16px 8px 12px padding, a 34px height, and the lg shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.53) 0 2px 16px`. It is the heaviest shadow in the system and breaks the tonal-elevation rule. That is allowed because it must stay legible over arbitrary moving video inside the ember-framed hero player.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every h1 and h2 in Besley 400 at 70px or 50px with −0.04em tracking — the serif at regular weight is the system's voice, and size alone carries rank.
- Fill primary actions with #000000 on a 30px radius at 14px 20px padding — action is signalled by ink density, not hue.
- Keep the canvas at #fbf5f0 and lift panels to #ffffff — warm linen under white produces elevation without a shadow.
- Recess grouped content such as stories, tiles and active tabs onto #f3ebe4 with a 20px radius — the tonal step replaces borders and keeps cards flat.
- Track all Muoto text negative, from −0.01em at 17px to −0.04em at 30px — the tight set unifies UI and body into one typeset texture.
- Confine #fa5d00 to the logo, hero underline, hero video frame and checkmarks — ember works as a signature stamp, punctuation rather than decoration.
- Use 100px between major sections and 24px between elements — the comfortable rhythm lets 50px serif headlines breathe like chapter openers.

### Don't

- Don't bold the serif headlines to 600 or 700 — weight 400 at 70px is the thesis, and a heavy Besley turns the ledger into a tabloid.
- Don't paint the CTA #fa5d00 — an orange button splits attention between brand mark and action, and black-only actions are non-negotiable.
- Don't swap Besley for a geometric sans at 50px — the serif-on-SaaS contrast is the identity, and a sans h2 makes Harvest indistinguishable from every time tracker.
- Don't add borders to story cards on #f3ebe4 — a 1px #d3d3d3 frame around a tonal card double-codes the boundary and reads as wireframe.
- Don't use the lg shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.53)` on cards — it belongs only to overlays on video, and on linen it reads as a dropped sticker.
- Don't set long paragraphs in #8b8b8b — at 3.2:1 on #fbf5f0 Ash Caption is for 1–3 line descriptions only, and body copy belongs in #000000 or #626262.
- Don't open up tracking on the 13px uppercase eyebrows beyond 0px — wide-tracked caps are the SaaS default, and this system never loosens its type.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Linen Canvas | `#fbf5f0` | Page body, hero, feature-tab section and logo strip |
| 1 | Sand Surface | `#f3ebe4` | Recessed groupings: story cards, integration tiles, active tab |
| 2 | Paper | `#ffffff` | Lifted planes: floating nav, mega-menu, carousel band, tab tray |
| 3 | Jet | `#000000` | Inverted fills: primary pill, approval toast, monochrome logos |

## Elevation

- **Floating nav pill, hero email tray, tab tray:** `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07) 0px 0px 14px 0px`
- **Mega-menu dropdown panels:** `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) 0px 4px 16px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 0px 1px 3px 0px`
- **Warm-cast product mockup inset (brown-tinted, paper-matched):** `rgba(123, 85, 31, 0.21) 0px 4px 10px 0px`
- **Video overlay controls (Unmute):** `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.53) 0px 2px 16px 0px`

Only four shadow declarations exist across six sections, and the dominant elevation mechanism is tonal: linen → sand → white. The md shadow is tinted rgb(123, 85, 31), a brown rather than black. That shadow is cast in the paper's own pigment, which stops it from greying the warm canvas, a rare piece of chromatic care compared with the neutral-black shadows of conventional UI kits.

## Imagery

Harvest pairs two image modes. The first is monoline spot illustrations: stopwatches, receipts and charts drawn in 1px Onyx strokes with a single #fa5d00 accent such as a timer badge or dollar coin, sitting unframed on white. The second is cropped product vignettes inside 20px-radius sand or linen containers. The vignettes show real UI fragments (billable-rate editors, bar charts, estimate tables) with their saturated greens, blues and reds treated as mockup-internal colors, not system tokens. The hero runs an autoplay product video inside a thick ember frame with a 20px radius. Icons are 1px outline glyphs at roughly 16px. There are no gradients, glows or orbs, and photography is absent from the captured frames. The imagery tells the story of a craftsman's toolkit: hand-drawn instruments beside the actual software.

## Layout

Content is held to a 1296px max-width centred on a 1920px canvas, with 1880px reserved for full-bleed bands and narrower 900px and 720px measures for centred serif headlines. Sections stack at 100px gaps and alternate between linen and white bands, which carry the rhythm without dividers. The hero is two columns: centred Besley display text, a lede, the email capture and trust ticks on the left, and the ember-framed video on the right, followed by a ruled logo wall. Feature content runs as a 4-up horizontal carousel of 350px columns, then a tabbed demo with a 1:2 text-to-panel split, then a 3-up tile grid followed by a 2-up row. The nav is a fixed floating white pill with the logo left, menus centre and actions right, in a 93px header zone. The captured footer element is a testimonial attribution at 16px #626262; build the site footer as a linen band with 13px uppercase eyebrows over 16px link columns. At 375px, display drops to the 50px heading token, h2 drops to 30px heading-sm, and sections collapse to 60px gaps. The density is comfortable.

## Serif Restraint

Harvest's defining discipline is Besley at weight 400 for every h1 and h2, a book serif in a category built on bold sans headlines. The restraint shows in the numbers: one weight, three sizes (18, 50, 70px) and one tracking ratio of −0.04em. Rank comes only from the 1.4 jump between 50 and 70px. The discipline breaks the moment someone bolds a headline to 600, italicises it for emphasis, or sets a feature h3 in the serif. The 30px Muoto h3 exists precisely so the serif stays rare. To extend the system, add new headline sizes only on the 1.4 ratio (36px below, 98px above) and keep the weight at 400. Any new emphasis should come from an ember underline or from black against #8b8b8b, not from stroke weight.

## Ember Rationing

The chromatic budget is one hue, #fa5d00, and the measured data records exactly one text use of it, the logo link. Every other appearance is a brand stamp in the hero: the underline, the video frame and the trial ticks. This rationing is what lets black CTAs read as authoritative. What breaks it: orange hover states, orange links in body copy, orange section backgrounds, or ember chart bars that compete with the product mockups. To extend the system, treat ember as a mark of authorship rather than a UI state. It may appear in spot-illustration details and on one highlighted data series, never more than once per viewport outside the hero. Status colors live only inside product screenshots, labelled mockup-internal.

## Tonal Stacking

Depth comes from pigment, not projection. Linen #fbf5f0, sand #f3ebe4 and white #ffffff form a three-step stack in which white is lifted and sand is recessed, so a card needs neither border nor shadow to separate itself. Even the one warm shadow is tinted rgb(123, 85, 31) to match the paper. The stack breaks when a builder drops grey #f5f5f5 or cool blue-greys into a panel, adds 1px borders to sand cards, or places white cards on white bands. To extend it, alternate section bands strictly between linen and white, put sand cards only on those bands, and reserve shadows for floating chrome: the nav, menus and video overlays.

## Similar Brands

- **Getharvest** — shares Mailchimp's move of pairing a characterful serif headline with a warm off-white canvas and black buttons, though Harvest uses a single ember hue where Mailchimp leans on yellow.
- **Getharvest** — mirrors Notion's black-pill CTAs, monoline spot illustrations and tonal cream surfaces, but swaps Notion's sans headlines for a regular-weight slab serif.
- **Getharvest** — competes with Toggl Track in time tracking, yet replaces Toggl's saturated purple-and-pink palette with a single-accent ledger palette.
- **Getharvest** — echoes Anthropic's combination of a serif display face, a warm linen canvas and a burnt-orange accent rationed to brand marks.
- **Getharvest** — resembles Basecamp in positioning a business tool through editorial warmth rather than dashboard spectacle, with far tighter typographic tracking.
